# GoodLeads MCP server

> Owner contacts for newly formed US businesses, the morning after the state posts the filing. Remote MCP server, no key, no account.

- Door (remote MCP server, Streamable HTTP, stateless): https://mcp.goodleads.club/mcp
- Agent quick start (start here): https://app.goodleads.club/llms.txt
- Help page for people, with per-client steps: https://app.goodleads.club/connect.html
- Registry name: club.goodleads/new-business-owner-contacts (official MCP Registry)

## What it does

- Your agent says who you sell to; GoodLeads quotes the list and hands back a payment link.
- Buying path: interpret_list -> quote_list -> browse_leads (masked rows) -> checkout_list.
- Reading is free: real records, names / phones / emails masked. Nothing is charged until a person completes checkout.
- Prices: name and address $0.25 per record; plus one verified phone or email $0.50; plus both $0.70. Live prices come from the quote, never from copy.

- Sample file (ten made-up records, every column): https://app.goodleads.club/api/v1/commerce/sample-file?format=xlsx
- Live states: https://app.goodleads.club/api/v1/leads/states
